title: Claude Code usage optimizations
description: Written by the claude-usage:optimize skill. Rendered as the report's Optimizations tab; applied change by change with scripts/apply.py (preview, backup, undo). Check with: python3 scripts/validate.py optimizations <file> --metrics <out>/metrics.json --insights <out>/insights.json

first.description: Leads the Optimizations tab, in Start here (the cache-lifetime pin comes with it); at most 3

problem.description: What it fixes, with the numbers from the report

usd_so_far.description: The saving over all the analysed days (all time)

usd_per_month.description: The same saving per 30 days: usd_so_far × 30 / days covered

related.description: How this optimization interacts with the others in this file. Both sides list the pair with the same relation, except requires (listed only by the one that needs the other).

id.description: Another optimization's id in this file

relation.description: alternative: two ways to fix the same cost, pick one (once one is in place the other adds little); conflicts: don't combine, they work against each other; overlaps: both worth doing, but their savings count some of the same cost, so they don't add up; complements: each makes the other work better; requires: apply the other one first

note.description: Why, in one sentence, from this optimization's side; for alternative, which to pick when

apply.description: Present only when apply.py can make the change; scripts/policy.py fixes which files, settings keys and hook commands a step may touch

path.description: write_file: ~/.claude/hooks/claude-usage/<the source's name>; append_text: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; the JSON actions: ~/.claude/settings.json or a project's .claude/settings.local.json

source.description: write_file: a file bundled with the plugin, relative to scripts/ (hooks/*.py, hooks/*.sh, prices.json)

content.description: append_text: the lines to add (at most 8)

value.description: merge_json: object to deep-merge; set_json: value to set

marker.description: append_text: an id that makes the append idempotent

manual.description: How to do it by hand
